# Elite Bot Studios

> Embedded Intelligence. Real-World Power.

Elite Bot Studios is an independent engineering initiative and evolving portfolio by Muhammad Shahzaib Abbas, an Electrical Engineering undergraduate at the National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST), Pakistan. His academic direction is power engineering; related interests include embedded systems, power electronics, electronics, control, and intelligent energy systems.

The public portfolio separates concepts and educational models from project evidence. The Smart Energy Monitoring entry is a concept, not a prototype. Calculator plots are generated from documented ideal models; no hardware measurements are implied.

## Pages

- [Home](https://elitebotstudios.me/): interactive conceptual power-control system, engineering focus, project direction, and academic profile.
- [Projects](https://elitebotstudios.me/projects.html): evidence-labelled records, a conceptual system architecture, and separately marked future directions.
- [Smart Energy Monitoring concept record](https://elitebotstudios.me/projects/smart-energy-monitoring.html): an illustrative functional architecture and open design questions; no selected parts, prototype, simulation, or measured results are claimed.
- [Expertise](https://elitebotstudios.me/expertise.html): academic foundation, practical exploration, and research interests linked as a system map.
- [Engineering Lab](https://elitebotstudios.me/lab.html): Markdown-authored technical notes, including [PWM fundamentals](https://elitebotstudios.me/lab/pwm-duty-frequency-resolution.html), [the ideal buck-converter CCM model](https://elitebotstudios.me/lab/buck-converter-ccm-model.html), simulation versus measurement, and documentation.
- [Engineering tools](https://elitebotstudios.me/tools.html): six browser-side calculators and an interactive ideal-CCM buck converter explorer.
- [Capabilities & collaboration](https://elitebotstudios.me/services.html): transparent areas of study and possible collaboration.
- [About](https://elitebotstudios.me/about.html): founder profile and academic/research direction.
- [Contact](https://elitebotstudios.me/contact.html): prepares a local email draft; the visitor must press Send. No website form backend is configured.

## Sources and limits

- The buck explorer uses the ideal steady-state CCM duty and inductor-ripple relationships. It does not solve DCM, device losses, controller dynamics, thermal behavior, or switching transitions.
- Other calculators also show their assumptions and intended limits on their pages.
- The calculator UI processes inputs in the browser and does not send them to a calculation API.

## Content sources

Lab-note Markdown: `content/lab-notes/`
Project index: `projects.json`
Project record standard: https://elitebotstudios.me/project-template.html (downloadable Markdown checklist: `/project-template.md`)

Contact form: posts to the site's own /api/contact endpoint; if mail delivery is not configured on a deployment, the page opens a local email draft and says so. Direct address: contact@elitebotstudios.me
